articles.title: Bitcoin, Ethereum-linked protocols lose $35 million in multiple attacks hours apart
articles.snippet: The attacks hit Verus, B² Network and other cross-chain systems, showing how compromised keys, upgrade powers and validation checks can empty protocols without breaking the underlying cryptography.

articles.title: Arbitrum-based AFX Trade drained of $24 million after bridge keys compromised
articles.snippet: Security firms said the attacker used enough hot-validator signatures to approve a 24.15 million USDC withdrawal, while Arbitrum said its native bridge was not affected.

articles.title: Here’s why the CLARITY Act’s ethics deal may be so hard to reach
articles.snippet: Both parties say they want US crypto market structure legislation, but a dispute over ethics rules and who enforces them is becoming the bill’s biggest obstacle.

articles.title: Home invasions became most common crypto wrench attack in H1 2026: CertiK
articles.snippet: Crypto home invasions rose to 20 in H1 2026 from one a year earlier, while France accounted for 33 of 52 verified wrench attacks, according to CertiK.

articles.title: Hackers steal $31.6M in 2 crypto bridge attacks within 7 hours
articles.snippet: AFX, a decentralized perpetual exchange operating on Arbitrum, reportedly lost $24.15 million on Wednesday, while the Verus Ethereum bridge was attacked hours later.
